# CANDIDATE: ORB_VWAP_BREAK_SHORT_WITH_VOL_SPIKE

**Filed:** 2026-09-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A break below the opening‑range low coupled with a simultaneous VWAP break and a volume spike signals short‑term seller dominance, offering a short entry. This captures early-session seller momentum when volatility is elevated (VIX > 18), avoiding low-VIX choppy environments where false breaks occur.

## Mechanism

Entry: Trigger when (1) low of first 5‑min bar (opening‑range low) is broken, (2) close of that bar is below VWAP, (3) bar volume > 1.8× average volume of first five 5‑min bars. Enter short at bar close. Exit: Stop at opening‑range high (chart‑stop). Target 1: VWAP of same day (or 1× ATR). Runner: trail 10% below highest high since entry. Regime filter: Only active when VIX > 18 and within first 30 min of session; skip if VIX < 12.
